name: Hopple
look: a cute grey bunny with a big round head, huge ears, big red eyes, a fang in its grin and a fluffy white collar
entry: A timid little rabbit that is never far from its den. When one is in danger it thumps the ground, and its whole family comes running.
how: Wild: common in plains, grasslands and forests.

Family form: with three or more Hopples in your party, open the interaction wheel on a Hopple that knows Call of the Den and choose Call of the Den. Every Hopple in the party fuses into one Rabbrute (needs CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.10.0 or later).
